name: Races
overview: Scripture reveals that God is sovereign over all nations and peoples, having made all from one blood and without partiality or favoritism (Acts 17:26; Acts 10:34; Deuteronomy 10:17). All humanity shares one Creator and Father, emphasizing our unity despite diverse races (Malachi 2:10). Christ's command to love one another and to make disciples of all nations underscores the call to embrace and minister across all racial and ethnic boundaries (John 13:34; Matthew 28:19). This foundation encourages believers to view racial distinctions as part of God's design rather than barriers, fostering love and unity within the body of Christ.
